members.name: width
members.doc: Preferred width of the chart in px; it shrinks to fit a narrower container. Default 160.

members.name: height
members.doc: Height in px at the preferred width; the chart keeps this aspect ratio when it shrinks. Default 52.

members.name: labels
members.doc: One label per point, such as a date. It replaces the change while that point is scrubbed.

members.name: formatValue
members.doc: Formats a scrubbed point for the headline. Defaults to a grouped number.

members.name: area
members.doc: A quiet neutral fill under the line.

members.name: interactive
members.doc: Pointer and keyboard scrubbing through the points.
